message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically takes about **6 – 7 hours** under normal conditions. The route is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) via I‑5 S, and the actual time can vary depending on traffic, weather, and stops along the way. If you’re heading during rush hour or on a holiday, you might want to allow an extra hour or two.
